subject: Weapons
intro: Top weapons ranked by damage, utility and drop accessibility, with where to get each one.

entries.name: Stormcaller Bow
entries.note: Chain lightning on crit. Drops from the Skyover final boss.

entries.name: Bulwark Greatsword
entries.note: Best stagger in the game. Craftable at Forge level 3.

entries.name: Emberstaff
entries.note: AoE burn stacks. Buy from the faction vendor after rank 2.

entries.name: Pilgrim's Warhammer
entries.note: Solid hybrid option until you unlock endgame drops.
